[amulet_strazniczy].description.t: A worn metal token on a leather thong, stamped with the watchtower's mark. Ragnosława wore it under her shirt, against her skin.

[amulet_wilczy].description.t: A wolf's tooth and a tuft of fur. You're the first to hear someone coming.

[belt_wybuchowy].description.t: A pouch of powder and a fuse tied behind the head. Crossbowmen don't like carrying them.

[belt_wzmocniony].description.t: A socketed head and an iron-shod shaft. Goes in deeper than a plain one.

[bimber].description.t: Cloudy and sharp, and it warms your insides like a stove.

[bochen_dla_grabarza].description.t: A big loaf of rye bread wrapped in a cloth. Still warm.

[bulawa].description.t: A heavy head on an iron haft. Whoever gets hit won't ask what for.

[bulawa_u1].description.t: A heavy head on an iron haft. Whoever gets hit won't ask what for. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[bulawa_u2].description.t: A heavy head on an iron haft. Whoever gets hit won't ask what for. Reshod with harder iron where it strikes. Bites into armour more easily.

[bursztyn_blednika].description.t: Warm to the touch, though nothing warms it.

[buty_wartownika].description.t: A pair of resoled boots, tied together with rawhide cord. One boot's not the same colour.

[buty_wedrowca].description.t: Soft, comfortable and good for running away.

[czapa_kolcza].description.t: A mail hood worn under a hat. What nobody sees, nobody knows.

[flasza_oleju].description.t: Oil and a wick. You throw it, it catches, the enemy dances.

[futro_lisa].description.t: Red and soft. A furrier will be glad of it.

[garnek_huku].description.t: A pot of powder and nails. The bang shakes the thoughts right out of your skull.

[garniec_wapno].description.t: Clay, quicklime and a good swing.

[grzebien_kosciany].description.t: Carved, with a few teeth missing.

[grzyby].description.t: A handful of forest mushrooms. Edible? The devil knows.

[gulasz].description.t: A bowl of thick barley stew, still warm from the pot. A man walks steadier after that.

[helm_skorzany].description.t: Hardened leather. Good against stones and harsh words.

[helm_straznika].description.t: Thick steel, goatskin lining. Your head stays put, and so does what's in it.

[helm_zelazny].description.t: An iron pot with a nasal. Rings when someone hits it.

[jagody].description.t: A handful of wild berries. Sweet, but they'll spoil by evening.

[kaftan_przeszywany].description.t: A thick layer of quilted linen. In summer it cooks you like a sheepskin coat.

[kaftan_przeszywany_u1].description.t: A thick layer of quilted linen. In summer it cooks you like a sheepskin coat. Relined with thicker leather.

[kaftan_przeszywany_u2].description.t: A thick layer of quilted linen. In summer it cooks you like a sheepskin coat. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[kaftan_wlocznika].description.t: A thick jacket with leather sewn on. Leaves the arms free to swing a shaft.

[kaftan_wlocznika_u1].description.t: A thick jacket with leather sewn on. Leaves the arms free to swing a shaft. Relined with thicker leather.

[kaftan_wlocznika_u2].description.t: A thick jacket with leather sewn on. Leaves the arms free to swing a shaft. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[kamien_zmierzchu].description.t: A dark, smooth stone, warm as a living hand. At night it pulses violet.

[kaptur_mysliwego].description.t: Keeps the glare and the dust out of your eyes.

[karwasze].description.t: Plates on the forearms. They save your bones from a cudgel.

[karwasze_rogowe].description.t: Horn plates for the forearms. They smell of cow, but they stop a blow.

[kastet].description.t: Iron for your fingers. Talk gets shorter.

[kastet_u1].description.t: Iron for your fingers. Talk gets shorter. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[kastet_u2].description.t: Iron for your fingers. Talk gets shorter. Reshod with harder iron where it strikes. Bites into armour more easily.

[kiel_dzika].description.t: Set in brass. Gives you strength, like the one who lost it.

[kly_wilcze].description.t: A handful of yellow fangs. For some cunning man's pendants.

[kobialka_ziol].description.t: Herbs from the marshes. They smell like an old cellar.

[kolczuga].description.t: Heavy and it jingles, but it keeps the blade off your skin.

[kolczuga_straznicza].description.t: Small, tight rings. The smith who wove it went blind earning his bread.

[kolczuga_straznicza_u1].description.t: Small, tight rings. The smith who wove it went blind earning his bread. Relined with thicker leather.

[kolczuga_straznicza_u2].description.t: Small, tight rings. The smith who wove it went blind earning his bread. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[kolczuga_u1].description.t: Heavy and it jingles, but it keeps the blade off your skin. Relined with thicker leather.

[kolczuga_u2].description.t: Heavy and it jingles, but it keeps the blade off your skin. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[kula_z_prochem].description.t: A lead ball and a measured load of powder, twisted up in paper.

[kurta_skorzana_u1].description.t: Tanned, stinks, but holds. Relined with thicker leather.

[kurta_skorzana_u2].description.t: Tanned, stinks, but holds. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[kusza_cesarska].description.t: The imperial armoury keeps these from common folk. This one walked out.

[kusza_cesarska_u1].description.t: The imperial armoury keeps these from common folk. This one walked out. New stock. Shoots truer.

[kusza_cesarska_u2].description.t: The imperial armoury keeps these from common folk. This one walked out. Stronger limb. Bolts bite deeper into armour.

[kusza_lekka].description.t: Quick to span, against the thigh. Only hits well up close.

[kusza_lekka_u1].description.t: Quick to span, against the thigh. Only hits well up close. New stock. Shoots truer.

[kusza_lekka_u2].description.t: Quick to span, against the thigh. Only hits well up close. Stronger limb. Bolts bite deeper into armour.

[kusza_zolnierska].description.t: Crank-spanned. Its bolt goes through mail and smooth talk.

[kusza_zolnierska_u1].description.t: Crank-spanned. Its bolt goes through mail and smooth talk. New stock. Shoots truer.

[kusza_zolnierska_u2].description.t: Crank-spanned. Its bolt goes through mail and smooth talk. Stronger limb. Bolts bite deeper into armour.

[list_gonca].description.t: Sealed with army wax. Don't read it, you won't like it.

[list_komendanta].description.t: A folded sheet with a seal shaped like a wolf's fang. The commander said not to read it, so you will.

[list_kopacza].description.t: A letter from a dead man's pocket, shut under an imperial seal. Jerzy the digger can't read it.

[list_zelazny].description.t: A writ under the command's seal: come back to camp of your own will and you won't hang. The captain signed it like his own death warrant.

[list_zolnierza].description.t: Last words, written in a shaking hand.

[loj_do_ostrza].description.t: A lump of tallow in a rag. Rub it on the blade and the edge bites where it should.

[luk_mysliwski].description.t: Quick, but misses a lot. The string's already fraying.

[luk_wojenny].description.t: Stronger than a hunting bow, only your arms ache.

[luk_zlozony].description.t: Horn, wood and sinew. Shoots far and true.

[maczuga_kolkowa].description.t: A stick with iron spikes. An argument, not a weapon.

[maczuga_kolkowa_u1].description.t: A stick with iron spikes. An argument, not a weapon. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[maczuga_kolkowa_u2].description.t: A stick with iron spikes. An argument, not a weapon. Reshod with harder iron where it strikes. Bites into armour more easily.

[mapa_przewodnika].description.t: A greasy sketch of the road, barely legible. The guide dropped it along with his bundle when he bolted.

[miecz_gwiazd_test].description.t: A trial piece of a relic weapon. For engine tests only.

[miecz_krotki].description.t: A short, broad blade. Just the thing in tight quarters.

[miecz_krotki_u1].description.t: A short, broad blade. Just the thing in tight quarters. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[miecz_krotki_u2].description.t: A short, broad blade. Just the thing in tight quarters. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[miecz_mistrza].description.t: Someone spent a whole winter on it. Not a village blade, not a brigand's.

[miecz_mistrza_u1].description.t: Someone spent a whole winter on it. Not a village blade, not a brigand's. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[miecz_mistrza_u2].description.t: Someone spent a whole winter on it. Not a village blade, not a brigand's. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[miecz_straznika].description.t: Forged in a good smithy, with a grip that doesn't slip in blood.

[miecz_straznika_u1].description.t: Forged in a good smithy, with a grip that doesn't slip in blood. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[miecz_straznika_u2].description.t: Forged in a good smithy, with a grip that doesn't slip in blood. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[miecz_zolnierski].description.t: Plain, sure and nicked just right. The army likes that.

[miecz_zolnierski_u1].description.t: Plain, sure and nicked just right. The army likes that. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[miecz_zolnierski_u2].description.t: Plain, sure and nicked just right. The army likes that. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[mieso].description.t: A hunk of raw meat. Roasted over a fire, it'll fill your belly proper.

[mieszek_zoldu].description.t: Sixty groats, the whole squad's pay, under the corporal's seal. The cardsharp won it, you're carrying it, the corporal wants it.

[miod_pitny].description.t: Sweet and treacherous. Warms you and heals a little.

[nagolenice_skorzane].description.t: Hard leather from the knee down. Somebody finally thought of the shins.

[nagolenniki].description.t: Plates on the shins. You waddle like a duck, but you keep your legs.

[napar_z_korzeni].description.t: Roots, bark and something the wise woman won't name. Tastes like a boot, works like a kick.

[napar_ziol].description.t: Bitter as wormwood, puts you back on your feet.

[naprawione_siodlo].description.t: A heavy saddle with a freshly stitched girth. Smells of leather and pitch.

[notatnik_ucznia].description.t: Ink-stained, with a star drawn on the cover.

[oberog_krwawienia].description.t: A knot of red thread. The old wives say it stops bleeding.

[odlamek_krateru].description.t: A lump of glass that remembers being flung down. Cold as ice, though it lies in the sun.

[odlamek_szkla].description.t: A dark, heavy shard that gets warmer in your fist than it should. Best spit over your shoulder.

[odtrutka].description.t: Bitter as wormwood. Flushes the venom from your blood.

[oklad_ziolowy].description.t: Linden, arnica and the wise woman's sly muttering.

[oko_nocy].description.t: A black stone with something glinting inside. The night gets a little brighter.

[opatrunek].description.t: Clean linen and a dab of wax. Stops the bleeding.

[orzechy].description.t: Hazelnuts. Hard as rock, but filling.

[ostrze_gwiazd_bogdana].description.t: Metal from the sky in the hands of a smith who knew what he was doing. Wraiths fear it, and rightly so.

[ostrze_gwiazd_bogdana].name.t: Blade of the Stars (forged by Bogdan)

[ostrze_gwiazd_surowe].description.t: Forged in a hurry, no fuss and no proper heat. Crooked, but star iron. The wraiths don't care if it's crooked.

[paciorek_pielgrzyma].description.t: One bead off a long string. Somehow your tongue loosens.

[paczka_kupca].description.t: A bundle in a rag, tied with three knots. Light, but someone's waiting for it.

[para_gwiazd_bogdana].abilities.[iskry]..t: The heads shower one enemy with sparks: 6–10 star damage, always hits and ignores armour, 35% chance to stun.

[para_gwiazd_bogdana].abilities.[powrot_.t: The thrown spear comes back to your hand from any distance and covers you against a blow on the way: defence +15 until the end of your next turn.

[para_gwiazd_bogdana].description.t: Two heads from the sky, forged by a smith who knows how to work two spears at once. Thrown, they come back to your hand, as if they had a conscience.

[para_gwiazd_surowa].description.t: Two uneven heads from the sky, forged fast and never reworked. Stabs just the same, only uglier.

[para_wloczni].description.t: Two short spears with long heads. They stab and they cut.

[para_wloczni_kutych].description.t: Heads forged to go through plate like butter.

[para_wloczni_kutych_u1].description.t: Heads forged to go through plate like butter. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[para_wloczni_kutych_u2].description.t: Heads forged to go through plate like butter. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[para_wloczni_lowieckich].description.t: Broad heads for boar. They do for people too.

[para_wloczni_lowieckich_u1].description.t: Broad heads for boar. They do for people too. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[para_wloczni_lowieckich_u2].description.t: Broad heads for boar. They do for people too. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[para_wloczni_strazniczych].description.t: Well balanced, with heads from a proper smith.

[para_wloczni_strazniczych_u1].descripti.t: Well balanced, with heads from a proper smith. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[para_wloczni_strazniczych_u2].descripti.t: Well balanced, with heads from a proper smith. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[para_wloczni_u1].description.t: Two short spears with long heads. They stab and they cut. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[para_wloczni_u2].description.t: Two short spears with long heads. They stab and they cut. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[pas_zolnierski].description.t: Five tie-straps and a buckle like a horseshoe.

[pas_zwykly].description.t: An oxhide belt with two straps for tying on gear.

[piesc_zelazna].description.t: An iron gauntlet, knobbed. You count teeth afterwards.

[piesc_zelazna_u1].description.t: An iron gauntlet, knobbed. You count teeth afterwards. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[piesc_zelazna_u2].description.t: An iron gauntlet, knobbed. You count teeth afterwards. Reshod with harder iron where it strikes. Bites into armour more easily.

[pistolet_skalkowy].description.t: One shot, a bang for miles and a stink of powder. Sometimes it misfires, damn it.

[pistolet_skalkowy_u1].description.t: One shot, a bang for miles and a stink of powder. Sometimes it misfires, damn it. New sight. Easier to aim.

[pistolet_skalkowy_u2].description.t: One shot, a bang for miles and a stink of powder. Sometimes it misfires, damn it. Trigger cleaned. The hammer falls true.

[pistolet_wojskowy].description.t: Longer barrel, better lock. Misfires less often, but it still misfires.

[pistolet_wojskowy_u1].description.t: Longer barrel, better lock. Misfires less often, but it still misfires. New sight. Easier to aim.

[pistolet_wojskowy_u2].description.t: Longer barrel, better lock. Misfires less often, but it still misfires. Trigger cleaned. The hammer falls true.

[plaszcz_cesarski].description.t: Red wool with an eagle stitched on. In it, people step out of your way, and scouts shout after you.

[plaszcz_lowczy].description.t: Green-grey, smells of the forest. Game won't notice you, and neither will people.

[plaszcz_skorzany].description.t: Leather that keeps out the rain and doesn't take kindly to knives.

[plaszcz_wedrowca].description.t: Grey, blends right into the mud.

[podkowa_szczescia].description.t: Small, forged blind, hanging on a thong. It helps, somehow.

[pokwitowanie].description.t: A slip with Ostromir's mark on it, like a drunk hen walked across it.

[polpancerz].description.t: Plate on chest and back. You walk like a barrel, but barrels don't die of arrows.

[polpancerz_u1].description.t: Plate on chest and back. You walk like a barrel, but barrels don't die of arrows. Relined with thicker leather.

[polpancerz_u2].description.t: Plate on chest and back. You walk like a barrel, but barrels don't die of arrows. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[prowiant].description.t: Dry bread, a slab of fatback and a skin of water. Enough for a day on the road.

[puszka_szerszeni].description.t: A clay jar stoppered with a rag. Don't shake it, God forbid.

[rdzen_maszyny].description.t: A heavy cylinder of copper and glass, torn out of the wreck. Every so often it pulses to a rhythm you don't know.

[rekawice_kolcze].description.t: Mail over the hands. A blade slides off your knuckles.

[rekawice_lucznicze].description.t: Leather, with the fingers left bare.

[rekawice_nabijane_u1].description.t: Leather, nails and good intentions. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[rekawice_nabijane_u2].description.t: Leather, nails and good intentions. Reshod with harder iron where it strikes. Bites into armour more easily.

[rekawice_skorzane].description.t: Thick and warm. Keep a fist warm all winter.

[rog_utopca].description.t: A horn green with slime. Sometimes it stinks even after washing.

[rusznica].description.t: The bang carries to the next village. The enemy flips, you get it in the ear.

[rusznica_u1].description.t: The bang carries to the next village. The enemy flips, you get it in the ear. New sight. Easier to aim.

[rusznica_u2].description.t: The bang carries to the next village. The enemy flips, you get it in the ear. Trigger cleaned. The hammer falls true.

[sakiewka_odlamkow].description.t: The glass jingles like small coin. Don't turn the pouch to the light.

[skora_dzika].description.t: Thick and stinking. A tanner will give you a few groats for it.

[skorznia_nabijana].description.t: Leather with small plates sewn on. Creaks at every step.

[skorznia_nabijana_u1].description.t: Leather with small plates sewn on. Creaks at every step. Relined with thicker leather.

[skorznia_nabijana_u2].description.t: Leather with small plates sewn on. Creaks at every step. Plates added where the cuts land most.

[skrzynia_zoldu].description.t: An iron-bound chest under the command's seal. It clinks inside. Outside, it smells of trouble.

[skrzynka_gwozdzi].description.t: A small iron-bound box with nails rattling inside. Heavy for its size.

[srebrny_kubek].description.t: Off a merchant's wagon. The owner won't be asking.

[strzala].description.t: A shaft fletched with chicken feathers.

[swieca_dymna].description.t: A few turns of thick, choking, stinking smoke.

[swiece_woskowe].description.t: A bunch of beeswax candles tied with bast. What drips off them is wax, not piety.

[szara_trzcina].description.t: A bundle of wet, dark reed from the Greywater Marshes. Dobrawa the wise woman brews a fever draught from it.

[sztylet].description.t: Short and nasty. Good in the off hand while the other one holds a sword.

[sztylet_zbojecki].description.t: Narrow, nasty and always to hand. Clean only on the outside.

[talizman_z_odlamka].description.t: A piece of cold metal from the stars. With it you're less afraid. Or so you think.

[topor_zbojecki].description.t: Chops firewood and bones with equal relish.

[topor_zbojecki_u1].description.t: Chops firewood and bones with equal relish. New grip. Sits surer in the hand.

[topor_zbojecki_u2].description.t: Chops firewood and bones with equal relish. Ground and sharpened all over. Bites into armour more easily.

[weksel].description.t: Ostromir's crumpled debt. Wrzosek the innkeeper would gladly squeeze it out of him.

[worek_zboza].description.t: Half a sack that the pedlar calls full. Ostap the miller has his own opinion on that.

[wosk_pieczetny].description.t: Red wax from Sister Halina. Handy for someone who knows his way around signet rings.

[zawieszka_stroza].description.t: Old guard badges. Your head sits tighter on your shoulders.

[ziola_dla_wrzoska].description.t: Bitter herbs. Wrzosek the innkeeper pays better for them than he feeds his guests.

[ziola_lesne].description.t: A handful of herbs off the forest floor. Crushed onto a wound, they help a little.

[zolc_zmij].description.t: A small phial. The wise woman will pay more for it than it looks worth.

[zwoj_pustelnika].description.t: A rolled parchment tied with string. Someone did careful reckoning on both sides.
